title: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter
responsibility: Preserve submitted task source as Git objects without moving source HEAD or changing user indexes.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.constructor.root
inputs.description: Owner repository checkout root used to compare its Git common directory with the task worktree; construction stores this path without checking it, and checkpoint performs the check.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.checkpoint.input
inputs.description: Task worktree context for a checkpoint: cwd selects the Git worktree, source is the commit that must still be at HEAD, and paths are the literal Git pathspecs to preserve. The worktree must share the configured root's Git common directory; an empty paths array returns source unchanged.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.checkpoint
outputs.description: Resolves to the source commit when paths is empty, otherwise to a new commit whose tree adds only the requested paths using a temporary index; the task worktree HEAD and user index remain unchanged.

errors.name: TaskWorktreeChangedError
errors.description: Thrown when the task worktree has a different Git common directory from the configured root, or its HEAD no longer equals input.source.
